sentences.text: Kuldeep Singh Khaira  ....Petitioner  Versus State of Punjab and others

....Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PARAMJEET SINGH DHALIWAL 1) Whether Reporters of the local papers may be allowed to see  the judgment ?
2) To be referred to the Reporters or not ?
3) Whether the judgment should be reported in the Digest ?
Present: - Mr. H.C. Arora, Advocate, for the petitioner.
Mr. S.S. Chandumajra, Addl. A.G., Punjab.

Instant writ petition has been filed for quashing the notification dated 08.08.2011 (Annexure P-2)
along with order dated 26.07.2013 (Annexure P-8) issued by respondent No.2 and also for quashing the appointment of respondents No.4 to 25 as Designated Officers, under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

Vide notification dated 08.08.2011 (Annexure P-2) District Health Officers in the State of Punjab were appointed as Designated Officers Food Safety under the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 and vide order dated 26.07.2013 (Annexure P-8) representation of the petitioner for appointment of whole-time Designated Officers in each District has been dismissed.

At this stage, learned counsel for the State submits that Government of Punjab, Department of Health and Family Welfare vide notification dated 31.03.2016 has already framed the Rules known as "Punjab Food and Drug Administration (Technical Group-A) Service Rules, 2016" wherein qualification in consonance with the provisions of the Act has been laid down.

entities.text: Punjab Food and Drug Administration (Technical Group-A) Service Rules, 2016
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Copy of the notification dated 31.03.2016 is taken on record.
In view of this, present petition is dismissed as infructuous.

However, authorities shall take a Kuldeep Singh Khaira vs State Of Punjab & Ors on 12 April, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43514763/
1 decision with regard to appointment of Designated Officers preferably within a period of two months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
